presentation-kit · software demo example · 2026

One task, shown in the product itself: fit a line to two datasets and look at the residuals.
The title is the conclusion of the demo, not the name of the product (principle 4). The subtitle states the evidence: the video comes from running code (S-entries, "show the real product").

The dashboard gives the same r for two very different datasets; the residuals tell them apart

Recorded with «kit.py demo» from app/index.html (demo.yml). Data: Anscombe (1973), The American Statistician 27(1), 17–21.

Let the video run; it zooms where each click happens. Press V to pause on the residuals.
One task per clip, scripted before recording, with the camera on the control in use and a visible cursor (signaling, F25; the software-demo catalog). The label in the video says where it was recorded from.

The video comes from running the code, step by step

  • demo.yml lists the task: open, choose a dataset, click, zoom, wait.
  • kit.py demo performs it in a real browser and takes a screenshot at every step.
  • Zoom, cursor and captions are added afterwards, from the positions of the real elements.
  • If there is no code yet, mockup: true stamps «Mock-up» on every frame.

presentation-kit: engine/demo.py.

This is the slide for whoever will record their own demo.
Says how the evidence was produced (principle 8) and separates a real demo from a mock-up, which a viewer cannot tell apart on screen.
